snippet.title: [Broken Drive] - Official Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
🩸 ABOUT FERRULE ENTERTAINMENT
We are an independent game development studio currently building an original, highly atmospheric psychological horror game in Unreal Engine 5. 
Our mission is to push the boundaries of environmental storytelling and deep psychological tension. 
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🔗 FOLLOW OUR JOURNEY
Don't miss our upcoming trailers, exclusive devlogs, and behind-the-scenes content! Follow us on social media to stay updated:
• Our Website:[ferruleentertainment.com]
• Instagram: [https://www.instagram.com/ferruleentertainment/]
